review: Fresh cross-check reproduces 432 raw decompiler-failure candidates: 378 main-flash and 54 bootloader. It compares each discontiguous body range against the 16306 candidate-byte partitions without double-counting ranges. 121 candidates have candidate-map evidence over every body byte; 311 have no mapped candidate bytes. The byte totals reconcile within each discovered body range, and saved source-index/partition hashes match.
limitations: 121 means byte-mapped only, not semantically recovered.
Raw function discovery is not a whole-firmware semantic denominator; body extents may be incomplete or overlap data/shared tails.
No candidates were admitted or discarded, and no C/gate status changes.
